text: The ___ correspondence, proposed by Maldacena in 1997, holds that a string theory (with gravity) in a (d+1)-dimensional anti-de Sitter bulk is exactly dual to a conformal field theory (without gravity) living on its d-dimensional boundary.
explanation: The expected answer is AdS/CFT (anti-de Sitter / conformal field theory), the most mathematically precise realization of holographic duality: the gravitational bulk spacetime is encoded in a lower-dimensional, non-gravitational boundary theory. It is the concrete example behind the claim that bulk spacetime — and hence its temporal structure — is emergent rather than fundamental.
